stories.title: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun

sources.title: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
sources.title_en: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
sources.title_original: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
sources.summary: While the company's minimum OS specifications officially say 4GB, most PC builders know that 16GB is the bare minimum for a smooth experience on Windows 11. However, the memory chip shortage and the resurgence of 8GB laptops are likely forcing Microsoft to optimize Windows.
sources.summary_zh: 虽然该公司的最低操作系统规格官方称 4GB，但大多数 PC 制造商都知道 16GB 是 Windows 11 流畅体验的最低要求。然而，内存芯片短缺和 8GB 笔记本电脑的复苏可能迫使微软优化 Windows。
